description: Merges Detect's facts with the agent's proposals into one plan: concrete mise versions, size, disk budget, status per row, and a diff against the saved toolchain lock. Checks the toolchain root is writable first. Blocks (routes to Approve) only when something needs installing.

params.label: Toolchain root
params.description: Shared mise data dir; every tool@version lives here once, for all projects. Empty = /data/toolchains when /data exists (Railway volume), else ~/.worca-cc/toolchains. Must be writable.

params.label: Keep free (MB)
params.description: Disk left untouched after the install.

portSummary: Reads facts, proposals; produces plan, summary, changes, unchanged.
